findings: The candidate follows the exact recovered odd-position ascending / even-position descending contract and the split-reverse-merge direction preserved by the source.
Position parity is explicitly distinguished from value parity, preventing a common contract misread.
Nondecreasing/nonincreasing, null handling, node mutability and duplicate tie behavior are labelled as candidate API assumptions where the source is silent.
The implementation reuses original nodes, detaches them safely during splitting, reverses only the even-position sublist and merges the two ascending sublists without auxiliary data structures.
The fixture covers nine fixed boundary cases plus 5000 deterministic randomized valid inputs against an independent full-sort oracle.
Node identity, node count and acyclicity checks independently constrain the in-place O(1)-auxiliary-space implementation claim.
No production experience, hidden online-judge contract or unsupported personal claim is fabricated.
